name: docs
description: 오피스 문서 읽기·만들기 — pptx·xlsx·docx·hwp·hwpx·pdf 를 읽어 텍스트·표·수식을 뽑고(hwpx 는 글상자·각주·수식 스크립트까지, 구형 .hwp 는 rhwp 엔진 — 옛 파일은 얇게 나올 수 있음), 렌더 블록(IR)으로 pptx·xlsx·docx·hwpx·pdf 를 만듭니다. 만든 파일은 미디어 보관함에 저장되어 바로 내려받을 수 있습니다. 회사 마스터 .pptx 를 올려 두면 그 서식 위에 만듭니다.

actions.name: 문서 읽기 (pptx·xlsx·docx·hwp·hwpx·pdf)
actions.description: Extract text and tables from an uploaded document — a media URL or workspace path in, {text, tables, meta} out. Works on pptx, xlsx, docx, hwp, hwpx, pdf. hwpx extracts text boxes, footnotes and equation scripts; legacy .hwp uses the rhwp engine and may extract thin from old files.

actions.name: PPTX 만들기 (렌더 블록 → 슬라이드)
actions.description: Build a .pptx from render blocks: header level 1 or divider starts a new slide; tables become native editable tables. Optional master pptx (media URL) carries the corporate theme. The file lands in the media store. IMPORTANT: pass the blocks as this tool's arguments (or blocksCacheKey) — blocks pasted into the chat reply render a page and make NO file.

params.title: deck title (title slide + filename)
params.masterMediaPath: media URL of a master .pptx to build on (falls back to the module's uploaded master setting)
params.theme: {accent, heading, body, band} hex tokens — the page palette rides along (ignored when a master is given)

actions.name: XLSX 만들기 (표 → 시트 · 대시보드)
actions.description: Build a .xlsx. Tables become styled data sheets: bold frozen header, fitted column widths, real number formats, and automatic conditional formatting (data bars on magnitude columns, a blue-white-red color scale on %/율/증감/change/delta/yoy columns). Dashboard genre: pass kpis and/or charts — or render blocks where metric blocks become KPI cards and chart blocks become native Excel charts — and a "Dashboard" sheet is placed first: white cards on a light slate page, laid out on one fixed 12-column grid — KPI cards up to four per row, stretched to fill the row (thick colored underline cycling blue/red/amber/green, optional emoji icon, up=red / down=blue delta) above native line/bar/pie/doughnut/combo charts that reference the data sheets' cells (chart blocks get their own data sheet). A kpi with style:"bar" instead becomes a progress-bar row (value + label + a live data bar against max). Ledger genre: a sheet with style:"ledger" is rendered as a document (centered docTitle, period line, fully ruled table, gray header) and subtotalBy inserts live [월 계]/[누 계] SUM bands per month. Any cell string starting with "=" stays a live formula, so pass formulas for totals and averages instead of precomputed numbers. A chart whose sheet or columns cannot be resolved is skipped and reported in data.notes. The file lands in the media store.

params.sheets: [{name, headers?, rows, style?, docTitle?, period?, subtotalBy?}] — a long row set goes as {name, headers, rowsCacheKey: "<the producing call's _cacheKey>"} instead of rows: the server expands the FULL cached rows, so a 120-day candle sheet carries 120 real rows and not the 5-row inline preview. style:"ledger" = 총계정원장 document styling with live monthly subtotals
params.blocks: render-block array (table → sheet, metric → KPI card, chart → native chart)
params.kpis: [{label, value (number or "=FORMULA"), delta?, unit?, icon?, style?, max?}] — KPI cards on the Dashboard sheet; style:"bar" turns one into a progress-bar row
params.charts: [{type: line|bar|pie|doughnut|combo, title, sheet, labelCol, valueCols[], unit?, centerLabel?, centerValue?}] — native charts pointing at a data sheet's columns (header name or 0-based index); combo = valueCols[0] bars + valueCols[1] line on a secondary axis; unit (e.g. "단위: 백만원") becomes a small badge on the chart's card; a pie/doughnut title is written as the card's header cell instead of inside the ring
params.title: dashboard/file title (row 1 of the Dashboard sheet + filename)

actions.name: DOCX 만들기 (렌더 블록 → 문서)
actions.description: Build a .docx from render blocks: headers become heading levels, lists become bullets, tables become real tables. The file lands in the media store.

actions.name: HWPX 만들기 (렌더 블록 → 한글 문서)
actions.description: Build a .hwpx (Hancom) from render blocks via the rhwp engine, seeded from a real Hancom blank so fonts and styles are valid. Headers become bold headings, tables become real editable tables. The file lands in the media store.

actions.name: PDF 만들기 (렌더 블록 → 문서)
actions.description: Build a .pdf from render blocks: headings, lists, real tables, images; divider = page break. Korean text via an embedded host font or the viewer-supplied CID font. The file lands in the media store.

actions.name: 셀프테스트
actions.description: Offline round-trip checks: make each format, read it back, compare. No key, no network.

action.description: read = document -> {text, tables, meta}. make_* = render blocks -> file in the media store. selftest = offline round-trips.

path.description: For read: the document — a media URL (/user/media/<slug>.<ext>) or workspace-relative path. Extension decides the parser (pptx/xlsx/docx/hwp/hwpx/pdf).

title.description: For make_*: title of the deck/document — first slide/heading and the stored filename.

blocks.description: For make_*: render-block IR [{type, props}] — the same blocks pages render. header{text,level} / text{content} / list{items,ordered} / table{headers,rows} / metric{label,value,unit,delta} / image{src} / divider. In make_pptx, header level 1 or divider starts a new slide. In make_xlsx, table blocks become data sheets while metric blocks become KPI cards and chart{chartType,labels,data|series,title} blocks become native charts on a Dashboard sheet. Render-fence dialect ({name:'Header',type:'component'}) is absorbed.

blocksCacheKey.description: Cache key holding the blocks array (from a previous tool result) instead of inlining it.

sheets.description: For make_xlsx: explicit [{name, headers?, rows}] — wins over the table blocks. Every sheet gets the bold frozen header, fitted widths, number formats and automatic conditional formatting. A cell string starting with "=" stays a live formula. NEVER retype a long row set: a tool result you saw only as a truncated preview carries a `_cacheKey`, so send that sheet as {name, headers, rowsCacheKey: "<that _cacheKey>"} and the server expands the FULL cached rows into it — a 120-day candle sheet then holds 120 real rows instead of the 5 preview rows. Inline rows win if both are given. Add style:"ledger" (+ docTitle, period, subtotalBy) to render that sheet as a 총계정원장-style document instead: gridlines off, centered docTitle over a centered period line, every cell thin-ruled, gray bold header, numbers right-aligned — and subtotalBy (a date column's header name or 0-based index) groups consecutive rows by YYYY-MM and inserts a live [월 계] band (=SUM over that month) plus a [누 계] band (=SUM from the first data row) after each month. A ledger sheet gets no data bars or color scales — it is a document, not a heatmap.

kpis.description: For make_xlsx: KPI cards on the Dashboard sheet — [{label, value, delta?, unit?, icon?, style?, max?}]. value may be a number or a live formula string ("=SUM(Data!B2:B100)"); delta colors itself (positive = red ▲, negative = blue ▼, zero = gray); each card takes a thick underline cycling blue/red/amber/green. icon = one emoji shown before the value ("💰" → "💰 334조원") — it makes that cell text, so skip it when the number must stay SUM-able, and it is ignored on a "=FORMULA" value. style:"bar" renders the kpi instead as a progress-bar row under the cards: the big colored number, the label, and a live data bar scaled to max (default 100) — the "34% 검색유입 매출 비율" / "4.11 고객 만족도" shape. Wins over metric blocks.

charts.description: For make_xlsx: native Excel charts on the Dashboard sheet — [{type: line|bar|pie|doughnut|combo, title, sheet, labelCol, valueCols[], unit?, centerLabel?, centerValue?}]. sheet = the data sheet name; labelCol/valueCols = header names or 0-based indices in that sheet. Data is read from cells, so the chart stays editable. type "combo" = valueCols[0] as muted bars + valueCols[1] as an accent line on a SECONDARY axis (two quantities, two units, one time axis — e.g. 수량 bars with 매출 line); it needs two value columns or it falls back to bars with a note; its bars carry value labels, its line does not. type "doughnut" = a ring; Excel cannot paint text in the hole, so centerLabel (small gray) over centerValue (large navy, e.g. "83.1%") is written into merged cells directly UNDER the ring, inside the same card. Layout is automatic: every chart becomes a white card on the slate canvas, a wide chart and a ring share one band (~2/3 + ~1/3) and a lone chart spans the full width, legends always sit under the plot, and every cartesian axis shows its tick numbers (#,##0, the combo's secondary axis included). A pie/doughnut title is NOT drawn inside the chart — Excel would center it over the ring — it becomes a bold navy header cell on that card's top row. Optional unit (e.g. "단위: 백만원") renders as a small amber badge at that card's top-right. Unresolvable charts are skipped and listed in data.notes. Wins over chart blocks.

masterMediaPath.description: For make_pptx: media URL of a master/template .pptx whose theme and layouts the new deck inherits. Omitted = the module's uploaded master setting, else a plain default deck.

maxChars.description: For read: cap on returned text length (default unlimited — large text is auto-cached).

transition.description: make_pptx slide transition: fade (default) | wipe | push | none.

theme.description: make_pptx design tokens when no master is given — {accent, heading, body, band} as hex colors. Use the palette you designed the page with; blocks carry meaning, these carry the look. A master .pptx always wins over this.

settings_fields.label: 마스터 PPTX 올리기
settings_fields.description: 회사 표준 서식(.pptx)을 올려 두면, 채팅에서 만든 발표자료가 그 서식(표지·폰트·로고) 위에 만들어집니다. 파일은 미디어 보관함에 저장되고 여기에는 주소만 남습니다.
